name: Real-ESRGAN x4 (plus)
summary: A fast, faithful 4× enlarger for photographs and artwork.
details: Enlarges a picture four times while sharpening and cleaning it, without inventing new content. It is the enlargement step of Atlas’s creative upscaling; the optional detail pass is added by the tile ControlNet. Large pictures are processed in tiles so they fit in modest graphics memory.
